_comment: clientId is NOT a secret (public-client SPA IDs are meant to be visible in client-side code) but IS environment-specific -- different deployments (e.g. gavinchow.me vs. deckcelerate.com) can be registered under different Azure App Registrations. The clientId value below is a placeholder, substituted at container startup by docker-entrypoint.sh from the AZURE_CLIENT_ID env var (same mechanism used there for the manifest's domain and manifest-id placeholders), into both this file (read directly by server.js) and the built dist/taskpane.js (esbuild bakes this file's clientId in as a literal string at build time, via src/auth/msal.ts's import). Defaults to the original gavinchow.me client ID when AZURE_CLIENT_ID is unset, so existing deployments need no .env change.
